$comment: Issue #1644 Stage 2 — Deno config for the collage re-encode tooling.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: scripts/package.json declares npm dependencies for the
Node-based scripts that live alongside these. Deno walks UP from the entrypoint,
finds that package.json, and switches to node_modules resolution — at which point
`npm:@jsquash/webp` fails with 'Could not find a matching package in the
node_modules directory', because scripts/ has no node_modules and never should.
Pinning nodeModulesDir to 'none' keeps this tooling on Deno's own global npm cache,
so it resolves identically on a laptop, in a spawned worktree (where node_modules is
a symlink into the anchor checkout — see COMMS-0130) and in CI. Without it the tool
works or fails depending on which directory you happen to run it from, which is the
worst possible property for a one-time 34,024-object migration.
